metrics.description: This metric shows the condition of the nodes.

job.template:
MASTER_NODES = data("container_cpu_utilization", filter=(filter("kubernetes_role", "master") or filter("sf_tags", "node-role_kubernetes_io_master")){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2, rollup="rate").scale(0.01).mean(by=["k8s.cluster.name", "k8s.node.name"])
MASTER_NODES.publish(label="Master Node")
NODE_CONDITION = data("k8s.node.condition_*"{{#filter}}, filter={{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2, rollup="latest").sum(by=["k8s.cluster.name", "k8s.node.name", "sf_metric"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the current condition of the nodes. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template:
READY = data('k8s.node.condition_ready'{{#filter}}, filter={{{filter}}}{{/filter}},extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=-1).sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.node.name']).equals(1).promote(by='condition', allow_missing={'condition':'Ready'})
NOT_READY = data('k8s.node.condition_ready'{{#filter}}, filter={{{filter}}}{{/filter}},extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=-1).sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.node.name']).equals(0).promote(by='condition', allow_missing={'condition':'Not ready'})
UNKNOWN = data('k8s.node.condition_ready'{{#filter}}, filter={{{filter}}}{{/filter}},extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=-1).sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.node.name']).equals(-1).promote(by='condition', allow_missing={'condition':'Unknown'})
NA = data('k8s.node.condition_ready'{{#filter}}, filter={{{filter}}}{{/filter}},extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=-1).sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.node.name']).map(lambda x: 2 if x is None else x).equals(2).promote(by='condition', allow_missing={'condition':'n/a'})
NODE_STATE = union(READY,NOT_READY,UNKNOWN,NA)

metrics.description: This metric shows the CPU utilization of node. Under 20% (green), over 80% (red).

job.template:
OTEL_CPU_USAGE = data('container_cpu_utilization'{{#filter}}, filter={{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, rollup='rate').sum(by=['k8s.node.name', 'k8s.cluster.name']).scale(0.01)
OTEL_CPU_PROCESSORS = data('cpu.num_processors'{{#filter}}, filter={{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).sum(by=['k8s.node.name', 'k8s.cluster.name'])
CPU_USAGE = ((OTEL_CPU_USAGE*100)/OTEL_CPU_PROCESSORS)
CPU_TIME = data('container.cpu.time'{{#filter}}, filter={{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, rollup='rate').sum(by=['k8s.node.name', 'k8s.cluster.name'])
SYSTEM_CPU_TIME = data('system.cpu.time', filter('state', 'idle'){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).count(by=['k8s.node.name', 'k8s.cluster.name'])
CPU_PRE_USAGE = ((CPU_TIME/SYSTEM_CPU_TIME)*100)
CPU_UTILIZATION = union(CPU_USAGE, CPU_PRE_USAGE)

job.template:
CAPACITY = data('container.filesystem.capacity', filter('sf_tags', '*',  match_missing=True){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.node.name'])
UTILIZATION = data('container.filesystem.usage', filter('sf_tags', '*',  match_missing=True){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.node.name'])
FILE_SYSTEM_UTILIZATION = ((UTILIZATION/CAPACITY)*100)
